autoContext: Validates transformData action. Covers: method param ('parseLines' splits text into numbered dict, 'map' applies multiply-by-2 to list), source param (key in previous_data holding the input data), graceful failure when source key is absent or method is unknown.

test_parse_lines._comment: PARAM: method='parseLines' — splits text on newlines into {1: line1, 2: line2, ...} dict. PARAM: source — key in previous_data holding the text.

test_map._comment: PARAM: method='map' — applies multiply-by-2 to each item in a list. Source must be a list. NOTE: shell output is a string; this demonstrates the handler's behaviour when given a non-list (it will process items of the string iterable).

test_missing_source._comment: PARAM: source pointing to a key not in previous_data — handler prints warning and returns None. Workflow continues.

test_unknown_method._comment: PARAM: method with an unsupported value — handler prints warning and returns None. Workflow continues.
